Property Dealer Shot Dead Outside Delhi Gym

A property dealer was shot dead outside a gym in Delhi's Narela area on Thursday morning. The victim, identified as Pramod, was a resident of Nahri village in Haryana's Sonipat district and worked in property dealings. Unidentified assailants shot him multiple times before fleeing the scene on a scooter. Police have reached the spot and are investigating the incident.
